name: switch
title: Switch
description: On/off setting that applies immediately. Three sizes, optional inline label, works inside Field and Form. An explicit aria-label takes precedence over the visible label; keep both consistent for WCAG 2.5.3 (label in name). The optional invalid prop exposes aria-invalid and a destructive 1px track ring, checked or unchecked. Invalid Field also supplies this state. Pair invalid with a FieldError or description explaining how to correct the value; colour alone is insufficient.
author: gntik-ai
